claim: The rewritten section doc says the smoothing function is used as a factor of `$1 \pm \varepsilon\,n$`, which renders as 1 ± ε·n (multiplication by n). In the Lean source `ε n` is function application, `smoothingFn n = 1 / log n`, so the new LaTeX misstates the factor that the proofs use (`1 - ε n`, `1 + ε n`).
requested_change: Replace `$1 \pm \varepsilon\,n$` with `` `1 ± ε n` `` (as the lemma docstrings in AkraBazzi.lean write it) or with `$1 \pm \varepsilon(n)$`.
evidence: file_read SumTransform.lean l.254-255 and l.268 (`noncomputable def smoothingFn (n : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / log n`, `local notation "ε" => smoothingFn`); AkraBazzi.lean l.457 and l.605 docstrings write the factor as `1 - ε n` / `1 + ε n`. lean_verify_edit with the backticked replacement compiles (success, no errors).
